messages.text: Map the chain from a AI market requirement to a measurable parameter and then to a required capability of Oscilloscope.

The passages support only a qualitative chain, not a numeric oscilloscope specification; they do not provide oscilloscope model, bandwidth, data-rate coverage, option code, fixture, or test-standard requirements [4][5][63][66][68].
| AI market requirement | Measurable parameter / test item | Required Oscilloscope capability supported by the passages |
|---|---|---|
| 【推論】AI / data-center connectivity is moving toward high-speed electrical interconnect, with examples such as OSFP cable assemblies from 25G/lane NRZ up to 224G/lane PAM4 and 200G/400G/800G/1.6T aggregate bandwidth, plus 224 Gb/s and 448G connector solution claims [3][60]. | Interface Test and signal-integrity observations such as Eye diagram, IL, Xtalk, and TDR Impedance are listed in the SerDes / SI flow context [4][62]. | Oscilloscope must support the Interface Test role, because Slide 11 maps Interface Test to scopes, BERTs, AWGs, and switch matrices; however, the source does not specify oscilloscope bandwidth, data rate, model, or compliance standard [4][5]. |
| 【推論】AI server PCB requirements include high-layer-count, large-area, high-speed transmission boards driven by AI server trends [77]. | PCB / PCBA signal-integrity flow lists IL, Xtalk, Eye diagram, TDR Impedance, Stackup Planner, and TL Calculator [4][62]. | Oscilloscope relevance is supported only for the scope-based Interface Test role and not as a complete PCB SI instrument mapping; the passages do not give the oscilloscope setup, fixture, standard, or pass/fail conditions [4][5][63]. |
| 【推論】AI server power demand is reflected in server power-supply items such as HVDC, 5–10 kW PSU, liquid-cooling power cabinet, BBU, and a role highlight saying Blackwell platform power consumption doubles and pushes high-density power demand [12]. | Power-related measurable items include PDN Target Z, power rail, multiphase DC, and PI [8][9][12]. | Oscilloscope must support PDN / power-rail / PI measurement roles, because PDN maps to scopes and network analyzers, and MXO is listed for power rail, multiphase DC, and PI; exact MXO option, probe, bandwidth, and calibration conditions are not provided [4][8][9][66]. |

- [[Compute tray component solutions]] 偏向 compute tray connectors、cables、power connector、busbar 與 backplane interconnect；本頁納入 optical transceiver、CPO、fiber deployment 與 liquid cooling。
- [[高速伺服器儲存互連]] 可連接本頁中的 [[Mini Cool Edge IO]]、[[Cool Express Link]]、[[Direct Attached Copper Cables]]、[[PCIe CEM 7 Connectors]] 與 storage / EDSFF 類產品。
- [[CPO]]、[[Optical I-O]]、[[Near-Packaged Optics]] 可連接本頁的 [[Amphenol Co-packaged Optics]] 與 [[LEAP On-Board Transceiver]]，但本來源不是技術標準或市場採用證據。

Data center full-spectrum connectivity › High-speed electrical connectivity

- [[Amphenol XtremePass]] — 來源稱 XtremePass 448G connector solution supports scalable form factors from 32DP to 128DP，並跨 Ethernet、NVLink、PCIe、InfiniBand systems。
- [[OSFP Cable Assemblies]] — 來源稱 OSFP cable assemblies compatible with 25G/lane NRZ up to 224G/lane PAM4，deliver aggregate bandwidths of 200G、400G、800G and 1.6T per cable assembly，available in Passive and Active variants。
- [[Sentry HD High-Speed Backplane Connector]] — 來源稱其是 next-generation high-speed backplane connector platform。
- [[Celerity 224 Gb-s BGA Mezzanine Connectors]] — 來源稱其 designed to support data rates up to 224 Gb/s PAM4。

R&S PCB test solutions › 來源中的說法
[[0 Digital Test - What are SIPI and Serdes]]（封面日期 2026.3.4）Slide 21 題為 **R&S PCB test solutions**，副標為 **PCB Fabricator and System House**，列出以下流程與項目：

- **Material Measurement**：Impedance ([[TDR]])、DK/DF extraction。
- **Material/Stackup selection**：IL、DK/DF、roughness、impedance、Xtalk、TL modeling、Eye diagram。
- **Signal Integrity modeling/testing**：IL、DK/DF、roughness、impedance。
- **Sampling testing**：IL、DK/DF、impedance。
- **PL/Process Monitoring**：來源列在同一流程上，但未展開 PL。
